definitions.explanation: Two occurrences or repetitions of an action. Formed from {二|に} (two) + the counter {回|かい} (times). Used for counting how many times something happens or is done.

examples.japanese: {一日|いちにち}{二回|にかい}{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I take medicine twice a day.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}に{二回|にかい}{会|あ}ったことがある。
{週|しゅう}に{二回|にかい}、ジムに{通|かよ}って{運動|うんどう}している。
examples.english: I go to the gym and work out twice a week.

notes:
{二|に} + the general counter {回|かい} (times, occurrences). {回|かい} is the most versatile counter for repeated actions; it can substitute for {度|ど} in most cases and is preferred from {四回|よんかい} onward.

HOMOPHONE WARNING:
Identical pronunciation to {二階|にかい} (second floor). Context usually makes the meaning clear, but be careful in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一日|いちにち}に{二回|にかい}: twice a day
- {週|しゅう}に{二回|にかい}: twice a week
- {月|つき}に{二回|にかい}: twice a month
- {年|ねん}に{二回|にかい}: twice a year
- {二回|にかい}{目|め}: the second time

COUNTING WITH {回|かい}:
- {一回|いっかい}: once
- {二回|にかい}: twice
- {三回|さんかい}: three times
- {四回|よんかい}: four times
- {何回|なんかい}: how many times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二度|にど}: twice (somewhat literary; often used for emphasis as in {二度|にど}と〜ない 'never again')
